title: Fix 4 (report-detail enrichment) has zero automated coverage — extras_for/income_sources_for/documents_for are private and no test asserts the baked PDF inputs
evidence:
extras: Some(extras_for(p.application_id)),
    snapshot: ApplicationSnapshot(
      application: p.row,
      co_applicants: co_applicants_for(p.application_id),
      income_sources: income_sources_for(p.application_id),
      documents: documents_for(p.application_id),
    ),
  ) — and `fn extras_for(application_id: String) -> String {` (line 599, private). `grep -rln pdf_prebake server/test/` returns nothing; the only report test (client/test/demo/report_download_test.gleam) pins only the id→filename mapping.
detail: The entire fix-4 behaviour (per-applicant verification_summary, income sources, document lists baked into the 8 PDFs) can silently regress — no suite asserts the enriched payload or PDF content/existence.
recommended_fix: Add a server unit test asserting extras_for/income_sources_for/documents_for output per applicant id (export for test or test via to_report_data), plus a CI check that all 8 report-a-*.pdf assets exist.

title: remind_applicant pins only the #(1,0) stage — the follow-up stage #(0,1) and unknown-email #(0,0) branches are untested
detail: The True->followed_up branch (True -> AwaitingApplicant(..a, followed_up: True, followup_due: False)) and the unknown-email path returning #(0,1) instead of the documented #(0,0) are unexercised.
recommended_fix: Add a pin dispatching UserClickedRemindApplicant for peter.lyons@example.ie asserting followed_up True and the #(0,1) pair, and one for an unknown email asserting #(0,0).

title: a-grace purge pin asserts presence of a-grainne but never absence of a-grace, despite its doc comment
evidence:
/// Fix 6: the a-grace residue is purged to the grainne id — the store serves
/// an "a-grainne" applicant and no "a-grace" id remains anywhere. — yet the body only asserts `detail.application.id |> should.equal("a-grainne")` and `list.contains("a-grainne") |> should.be_true`.
detail: A lingering "a-grace" key in e.g. movement_for or audit_for would not fail this test; the claimed 'no a-grace id remains anywhere' half of the pin does not bite.
recommended_fix: Add a negative assertion: application_detail(store, "v-maples", "a-grace") is Error, and report_filenames() contains no "a-grace" key.
